{{Top|leg}}
'''Universal Plasma Fluid Sacks''' were standard items included in [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]'s [[ECM-598 Medical Backpack]]. They provided an [[IV tap|intravenous feed]] allowing a patient to receive [[universal plasma stabilization serum]]s.
